title: Jawir thiyankir Guardian sat qillqata
intro: Mä markanjja, mä tirano chachan decretopajj walja utanakaruw llakisiyäna, mä almaw mä yatiyäw katoqäna, uka yatiyäwejj taqe ajjsarañanakaruw jan yäqkänti. Confianzampi phuqtʼat chuymampixa, iyawsäwimpiw mä markan sarnaqañap mayjtʼayañapäna. Umanakajj wali valorani carga aptʼatäjjäna ukhajja, suytʼañajj uma jalsunakampi chʼamaktʼäna.
clues: Diosan amuytʼayataw katoqayäta, ukaw jan ajjsarirïñ churitu.
Nayarojj jan ajjsarañajataki, jan llakisiñajatakiw mayïna.
Wawajarojj mä cajaruw uchayäta ukat uma patjjaruw uchayäta.
Wawajarojj apnaqirin utapanwa jikjjatäna, ukampis mayni wawajajj arktäna.
Wawajampiw wasitat jikisiyäta, kunjamtï Allah chachajj siskäna ukhama.

outcome.answer: Uka wawax jan kuna usuniw enfermera ukar kutt’ayatäna

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
